description: This file defines a command handler class 'MarkLoanAsFraudCommandHandler' which handles setting a loan as fraudulent in the system. It uses Spring annotations, Lombok for constructor generation, and interacts with a service to perform the action.

classes.name: MarkLoanAsFraudCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the 'SETFRAUD' command for loans, marking a specified loan as fraudulent in the system.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to mark a loan as fraud by invoking the corresponding service method.
